To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) current mobile cloud storage services cause unnecessary bandwidth consumption when users edit and synchronize documents in the cloud; (2) we propose EdgeCourier to address the issue; (3) EdgeCourier can effectively reduce bandwidth consumption with negligible overheads; (4) we also propose the concept and benefits of edge-hosed service.

EdgeCourier can reduce the bandwidth consumption for document synchronization in mobile-cloud storage services, and the concept of edge-hosted personal services can help deploy EdgeCourier in practice with many other benefits.
